notes: v486 — 🖨️ Printed reports now come out readable. Printing while the app was in the dark theme put near-white headings and pale grey text onto white paper, so half of a printed report card was effectively invisible. Anything you print or save as PDF now uses the light colours, whichever theme you have on screen — nothing changes about how the app looks while you are using it. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
